added_capabilities.preconditions: Finite nonempty ARC-color sequence and positive repeat count.
added_capabilities.semantics: Construct a square diagonal trail from a 1-D color sequence.

added_capabilities.preconditions: Nonempty foreground, nonzero direction, all copies in bounds.
added_capabilities.semantics: Preserve a foreground and add a finite series of copies translated from the original.
Preserve a foreground and add every original-relative translated copy while it remains in bounds.

added_capabilities.preconditions: All anchors fit the target canvas.
added_capabilities.semantics: Render one binary motif at an explicit finite set of anchors.

added_capabilities.preconditions: At least one frame and a unique external motif of matching interior extent.
added_capabilities.semantics: Move unique shape-matched external motifs into closed monochrome rectangular frames.

audit_protocol: generic train-derived candidates -> train exact -> development test exact oracle check; no recognition imports, outputs, or scores
leakage_audit: task IDs, candidate programs, grids, and solutions stay in ignored private artifacts; public aggregate contains no per-task data.
